candidate.original_question: What condition or exception is described in the clause beginning “Unless the Legislature of the State by law…”?
candidate.original_answer:
Unless the Legislature of the State by law otherwise provides, this
article  shall,  after  the  expiration of a  period of  fifteen  years from  the
commencement of this Constitution, have effect as if the words “or in English”
were omitted therefrom:
      1[Provided that in relation to the 2[Legislatures of the States of Himachal
Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya and Tripura] this clause shall have effect as if for
the words “fifteen years” occurring therein, the words “twenty-five years” were
substituted:]
      3[Provided further that in relation to the 4[Legislatures of the States of
5[Arunachal Pradesh, Goa and Mizoram]], this clause shall have effect as if for
______________________________________________
1.
candidate.proposed_question: Under the first proviso to Article 210(2), what period replaces fifteen years for the Legislatures of Himachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya and Tripura?
candidate.proposed_answer: For those Legislatures, "twenty-five years" is substituted for "fifteen years".
candidate.source_text_finding: The cited Article 210(2) proviso names Himachal Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, and Tripura and substitutes twenty-five years for fifteen years.
candidate.quality_or_scope_flags: The proposed answer is very short but directly responds to the substitution question. Preserve that it is a substitution for specified Legislatures under the proviso.
